raw_excerpt: GitHub Flavored Markdown Spec, Version 0.29-gfm (2019-04-06). 'GFM is a strict superset of CommonMark. All the features which are supported in GitHub user content and that are not specified on the original CommonMark Spec are hence known as extensions.' Extensions: Tables (extension), Task list items (extension), Strikethrough (extension), Autolinks (extension), Disallowed Raw HTML (extension). 'Markdown is a plain text format for writing structured documents... It was developed by John Gruber (with help from Aaron Swartz) and released in 2004.' ATX headings: 1-6 unescaped # characters, optional closing sequence. Setext headings: text + === or --- underline. Fenced code blocks: 3+ backticks or tildes. CommonMark is the underlying spec by John MacFarlane.
